All applications

Lightweight structures.
Advanced batteries.

Lightweighting and electrification call for strength and safety at lower weight. Synboli offers tailored polymer solutions to support these innovations.

Discuss this application

Polymers in
transportation.

Mobility and electrification require materials that balance strength, safety and weight. Synboli’s transport applications include lightweight components, battery materials, protective coatings and foams for comfort.

Synboli modifies PC and POM for stronger, more durable structural components. PEO and PVDF support solid electrolytes and battery binders. PU and PMMA improve protective coatings, while PU foams support comfort and vibration damping.
